title: Fixed insert_at_line parameter naming inconsistency with content alias
content: The LLM was calling `insert_at_line` with `content` parameter (from training data on other tools) but the tool only accepted `content_to_insert`. Zod rejected it: "params is not allowed to have the additional property 'content'". Fixed by adding `content: z.string().optional()` as an alias in the schema and resolving both parameters via `const textToInsert = content_to_insert ?? content` in the implementation. Applied to src/tools/fileSystemTools.ts. Backward compatible — original `content_to_insert` still works.

title: Fixed text_transform line deletion bug and added range support to line_operations
content: Debugged two issues: (1) text_transform tool was replacing matched lines with empty strings instead of removing them, causing cascading line number shifts for subsequent LLM tool calls. Fixed by using Array.splice(i, 1) instead of linesArray[i] = '' and adjusting loop bounds with i-- and endLine--. (2) line_operations tool didn't support range deletion — added optional `lines: { start, end }` parameter to the Zod schema and implementation so LLM can pass `{operation:'delete', lines:{start:16,end:17}}` instead of hallucinating invalid parameters like `start_line`/`end_line`. Both fixes applied to src/tools/textProcessingTools.ts.

title: Fixed path resolution in text processing tools to use working directory consistently
content: All file path resolution in AI Toolbox now uses `resolvePath()` from workingDir.ts consistently across every tool — both filesystem tools (read_file, replace_text_in_file, etc.) and text processing tools (text_transform, text_extract, line_operations). Previously, the 3 text processing tools used `pathModule.resolve()` which resolved against Node.js CWD instead of the project working directory. Fixed in src/tools/textProcessingTools.ts: updated import to include `resolvePath`, replaced all 3 occurrences of `pathModule.resolve(file_name)` with `resolvePath(file_name)`. Build and tests pass.

title: StateManager Persistence Default Fix
content: Fixed StateManager constructor to ensure statePersistenceEnabled defaults to true even when no config is passed (e.g., in tests or standalone usage). Previously, passing an empty object {} or undefined caused persistenceEnabled to be undefined → false, triggering the misleading warning: "State persistence is DISABLED. Data will not survive reloads." Fix uses null-coalescing pattern with explicit fallback to true, ensuring consistent behavior across all instantiation scenarios while still respecting explicit config overrides.

title: Backup Confirmation Workflow Implementation
content: Implemented two-step confirmation process for create_backup tool: Step 1 shows preview (directory, file count, destination) without creating archive; Step 2 requires explicit confirm=true parameter. Added targetDirectory parameter to allow backing up custom paths bypassing SDK sandbox context. This prevents accidental backups of empty/wrong directories and gives users full control over backup targets.

title: Archiver v8+ API Compatibility Fix
content: Fixed archiver package compatibility issue by switching from factory function pattern (archiver('zip', options)) to class-based instantiation (new ZipArchive(options)). This aligns with v8.0.0 release notes and ensures cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Linux). The old pattern threw "(intermediate value) is not a function" errors on certain Node.js environments.
